title: MCP 'help me choose' prototype: data snapshot
unofficial: Independent prototype for an assignment. Not affiliated with or endorsed by TrueFoundry.

catalog_snapshot.what: Public list and all 1,368 detail records from https://mcp-api.truefoundry.com/api/mcps

gateway_check.what: Tool discovery through the catalog's own gateway path, for the 680 entries labeled No Auth, with a retry of failures

direct_check.what: Direct MCP connection to every server URL without credentials: initialize, then tools/list if public, or OAuth protected-resource metadata if login is required. One retry for failures. No tool was ever called.

official_registry.what: Full listing of registry.modelcontextprotocol.io (121,343 server versions) matched to catalog servers by remote URL

manual_review.what: Provider documentation for the servers in the five developer journeys (Microsoft Learn, Ahrefs, Abbyseo, MetricSpot, Exa, Atlassian, GitHub, AgenticTotem, Find Me)

caveats: Every check is point-in-time. 'Failing' means failed twice minutes apart, not permanently dead.
A tool list readable without login does not mean every tool works without login.
Tool access labels marked 'declared' come from the server itself; the MCP spec says to treat them as untrusted hints. Labels marked 'inferred' are guessed from the tool name.
Cost labels are verified only for manually reviewed servers and servers that answered HTTP 402. 'Mentions pricing' is an unverified keyword signal.
'Owner verified' means the publisher proved control of a domain or GitHub account in the official MCP Registry. It does not by itself prove the publisher is the brand named on the card.
Estimated tokens = characters of the tool definitions divided by 4; a rough indicator only.
11 servers could not be checked from our network; they are shown as 'not checked', not as failing.
